title: Technical Writer
summary: Technical writers explain how software works to its users and developers, through user guides, help articles, release notes and API references. They sit in product or engineering teams and gather information from developers, product managers and testers.
dailyDuties: Interview developers and product managers about new features
Write and update user guides and help articles
Document APIs from OpenAPI or Swagger specs
Prepare release notes for each release
Review docs pull requests and fix formatting in Markdown or XML
Keep content consistent with the style guide

skills.expectation: Write user guides, how-to articles, release notes and online help for software
Document APIs from OpenAPI or Swagger specs and check them with test calls
Author in Markdown with a static site generator, or in DITA with a tool like MadCap Flare
Author in Markdown with a static site generator, or in DITA with a tool like MadCap Flare
Keep docs in Git and work through pull requests
Edit HTML or XML source and fix formatting
Explain technical features in plain, consistent language that follows a style guide
Interview developers, product managers and QA to gather and verify content
Try endpoints in Postman or cURL
Read code samples and script small docs tasks

groups.label: An authoring toolchain (docs-as-code or DITA/MadCap Flare)
